about: What every adapter of ports.IRASFiler must answer (FR-TAX-03, FR-TAX-06; p2-tax-filings design D5). IRAS's payload layouts for the GST return and Form C-S APIs are given to registered developers behind IRAS's sign-in and are not written here: the steps use an opaque payload, and the real adapter answers the steps without stub_only against IRAS's sandbox [live-verify] once access is granted.
sources: IRAS API portal, Submission of GST Returns (CorpPass) 1.0.4, apiservices.iras.gov.sg/iras/devportal/product/12693, retrieved 20 Nov 2026: submitF5ReturnCorpPass, submitF5F8ReturnCorpPass, submitF7ReturnCorpPass, submitTransactionListingCorpPass; payloads not shown
IRAS API Marketplace: Submission of Corporate Tax Records (Form C-S and pre-fill), named in a search of its listings on 20 Nov 2026

steps.name: the same key returns the same acknowledgement
a kind IRAS does not take is refused with its reason
a period that is not a day is refused
an outage fails the call and files nothing
